ui.extra.cacheClean:
1. Confirm that you opened Interstellar Collectibles or Warp history in Honkai: Star Rail
2. Close the game window
3. Click "Open cache folder" above and delete the Cache_Data folder
4. Launch Honkai: Star Rail and reopen Interstellar Collectibles history
5. Close this dialog and click "Update"
ui.extra.findCacheFolder: If "Open cache folder" does not respond, manually open "Your game install folder/Star Rail/Games/StarRail_Data/webCaches/Cache/"
